notes.title: DATAFLOW receives FREEdom
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!

This game is too old and pretty outdated. I decide to make it free.
There are two reasons:
[olist]
[*]I'm working on my brand Half-Face Games which will contain only free games.
[*]I believe every game should become free after sell time was over.
[/olist]

New players would play this game and our community will grow, I hope.

Everyone will be able to play Dataflow for free starting September 12th.
